metadata.feature_protocol: All history + time + household sensors (predeclared primary)
metadata.selection_metric: validation MAE, smallest wins; no test-based changes

provenance.method: urllib HTTPS official UCI ZIP; extract named CSV

metadata.target_definition: sum Appliances(t+1) through Appliances(t+6), Wh; row t observed at interval end
metadata.time_zone: Naive dataset clock: source does not supply UTC offsets. Do not convert to visitor timezone.
metadata.sensor_assumption: Household ten-minute sensor averages are assumed available at end of interval t. Airport interpolated weather excluded because it may use future hourly endpoints.

bootstrap.caveat: Day blocks preserve within-day dependence; dependence across days and one-household sampling remain. Partial boundary days retained.

metadata.integrity: Model and hyperparameters frozen in selection_frozen.json before the single final-test scoring stage. All frozen candidates refitted and reported for transparency.

audit.cleaning: No readings removed or winsorized. Fail on missing, unordered or irregular records.

bootstrap.caveat: Day blocks preserve within-day dependence; dependence across days and one-household sampling remain. Partial boundary days retained.

figures.title: Daily appliance energy (boundary days are partial)
figures.takeaway: Daily totals range from 5.40 to 27.15 kWh, including partial boundary days.

figures.title: Ten-minute appliance energy distribution
figures.takeaway: Median 60 Wh; 99th percentile 577 Wh. Large events are retained.

figures.title: Typical energy by clock hour
figures.takeaway: The largest full-dataset hourly mean occurs at 18:00; this is descriptive, not a causal explanation.

figures.title: Weekday and weekend consumption
figures.takeaway: Weekday mean 96.6 Wh; weekend mean 100.6 Wh in this limited record.

figures.title: Contemporaneous sensor correlations
figures.takeaway: Correlation is descriptive and does not establish causation or future predictive benefit.

figures.title: Future-hour target dependence
figures.takeaway: Adjacent targets have correlation 0.970; overlapping windows are not independent samples.

features.name: short_long_difference
features.definition: trailing mean 1h - trailing mean 24h, both inclusive
